text:
invoice-bot: New invoice received from Helion Analytics: INV-HL-342 for $12,300. PDF: https://invoices.redwood/INV-HL-342. Vendor cites PO: H-2207. Extracted GL: 4302. Flag: remittance/bank details changed on vendor PDF. Please review.

mara_fin: Heads up 52 52 vendor updated their remittance info in the PDF (different bank). We need procurement confirmation before paying. Also there are three line items: Platform access $8,000 (H-2207), Model retraining $3,000 (no PO), Travel $1,300 (should be on corporate card, vendor included it by mistake).

ton y_proc: Procurement did not issue a PO for retraining. Travel should have been expensed via employee card (we flagged this in the SOW).

eva_ops: @mara_fin please escalate vendor bank change to security & AP — this is high risk for fraud. Do we have a supplier validation on file?

nick_ap: AP will not pay to a new bank without a vendor bank-change form and procurement sign-off. Also need matching PO for retraining or a waiver.

lucas_eng: I can confirm retraining was approved verbally but no formal PO. If procurement can fast-track PO creation we can avoid delaying payment.

procurement-bot: Reminder: creating a new PO requires PR ticket, approvals from Eng manager and Finance. A bank-change requires vendor bank-change form and vendor contact verification.

mara_fin: Action plan: 1) I'll request vendor bank-change form and vendor contact by email right now; 2) Tony, can Procurement create PO H-2208 for $3,000 retraining with expedited approval? 3) If we can't get bank-change verification within 48h, hold total payment and request vendor to remit travel back to employee.

ton y_proc: I'll open PR-781 and tag for expedited approvals. ETA 4 hours to get PO draft. Procurement will also call vendor to confirm bank details.

vendor-bot: Auto-reply from Helion: "We can provide vendor bank-change form and confirm the remittance details. Travel line was included per our billing team error. We will credit travel if you request."

mara_fin: Great, attach vendor email to AP ticket. Nick, please note AP hold and do not process payment until vendor form is validated.

nick_ap: Got it. I'll set hold code: HOLD-FRAUD-CHK on invoice. Also will block auto-pay.

lucas_eng: If procurement can get H-2208 created today, I will approve the retraining PO. Otherwise we need a manual approval note attached to the AP ticket.

procurement-bot: PR-781 created. Worksflows: expedited approval requested; expected PO H-2208 if approvals complete.

mara_fin: Assigning owner: AP ticket AP-4309 created. Owners: @mara_fin (finance) and @tony_proc (procurement). I'll update when bank-change form received or PO H-2208 issued.

invoice-bot: Invoice INV-HL-342 status: vendor sent bank-change form and confirmation email (attached).

mara_fin: Received vendor docs. Please confirm vendor contact via phone call log in the procurement ticket.

ton y_proc: Called vendor; contact verified. PO H-2208 ready for approval. Tagging @lucas_eng for sign-off and @mara_fin for finance approval.

lucas_eng: Approved H-2208 for $3,000 retraining.

mara_fin: Finance approves H-2208 and vendor bank-change form. Removing HOLD-FRAUD-CHK. Nick, you can proceed with payment split: pay $8,000 to H-2207 matched line, $3,000 to H-2208, and request vendor credit $1,300 for travel (or deduct from remittance). Attach all emails and call log to AP-4309.

nick_ap: Payment scheduled for next run. Notes attached to AP-4309. Closing thread.

procurement-bot: PO H-2208 created and linked to invoice. PR-781 closed.

mara_fin: Thanks all. Audit note: "Manual verification of bank-change performed by Procurement (call log) and vendor-signed bank-change form attached. Travel item credited per vendor confirmation. PO added for retraining.""
